The '''Devastator Acid Launcher''' was a type of [[heavy weapon]] dedicated for use by [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] which projected blobs of [[Acid/Legends|acid]].<ref name="TOW" />
